data.one_liner: Provides annotations for the Cached code‑generator to define caching behavior.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies a set of annotations that the Cached generator uses to create caching logic, including persistent storage and update mechanisms. It does not contain runtime code; it only works together with the cached package.
use_when: You are using the cached package and want compile‑time generated caching logic
You need annotations for persistent, lazy, or updateable cache behavior
avoid_when: You are not using the cached package or prefer manual caching implementations
strengths: Rich set of cache‑related annotations (persistent, lazy, update, delete, etc.)
Works seamlessly with the cached code‑generator
weaknesses: No runtime functionality on its own
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency and run build_runner together with the cached package; no native permissions required
